subject: Error with nimbleMCMC but not other ways of using NIMBLE

messages.author: bfa4a88c8a5bc54e
messages.subject: Error with nimbleMCMC but not other ways of using NIMBLE
parts:
Hi,

My usual workflow with using NIMBLE is nimbleModel, compileNimble, configureMCMC, buildMCMC, compileNimble, and runMCMC. I'm trying to run the same model with nimbleMCMC as follows:

nimbleMCMC(code = cmrCode, constants = cmrConsts, data = cmrData, inits = cmrInits, cmrMons, nburnin = 5000)

but it gives me the error: 

defining model...
Error in dL[[constName]] <- constDim : replacement has length zero

I can't understand what's going on here, and it's not an issue when I just do nimbleModel. I'm happy to provide code, but perhaps finding out what the error message means would already help.

Regards,
Matt

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Error with nimbleMCMC but not other ways of using NIMBLE
parts:
Hi Matthijs,

Your 'cmrMons' is being treated as the dimensions argument to nimbleMCMC because you haven't named the argument. (I suspect you mean to pass 'cmrMons' as the monitors argument.)
The error message is not very helpful, unfortunately.

-Chris
